question: Provide a reusable check that accepts a fresh consistent record and rejects one whose reported front distance has been altered. For plain JavaScript use function valid(rateMmS,timeS,travelCm) returning a boolean (finite nonnegative inputs, no strip-end clipping within this test, tolerance 0.000001 cm). A native validator that replays and checks the corresponding full trial files is equally acceptable. We will test two genuine records and one altered distance. A description alone is insufficient.
